csd_structure.title: DIMACS SPG-GAPS input structure
csd_structure.interpretation: Independent structural derivation; no published optimum for these two rows was identified in the sources checked.
csd_structure.proof: Each input is K_q with every edge subdivided once, all subdivision vertices terminal, and every edge of cost 1. Every terminal needs an adjacent selected original vertex, so selected original vertices cover K_q and number at least q-1. Any q-1 original vertices together with all terminals induce a connected graph. A spanning tree therefore attains |T|+q-2 edges, meeting the lower bound.
csd_structure.verification: Checked that every terminal has two distinct nonterminal neighbors, the terminal neighborhoods are exactly all unordered pairs of nonterminals without repetitions, every edge crosses the terminal partition, and all weights equal 1.
